## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 174 captures during May 2020. Activity proceeded in line with the planned session arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that imaging was undertaken at the site throughout the reporting month. No additional operational issue is identified in the supplied information. The capture total provides the measure of activity for this report and is used as the basis for the image-quality assessment below.

## Image quality

Of the 174 captures, 7 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.0 per cent. The ungradable captures are reported separately from the graded results so that the quality of the images can be considered alongside the grading outcome. The rate is based on the activity recorded for May 2020 and provides the reported measure for West Gate Eye Clinic.

## Grading

A total of 33 results were referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. This grading information is reported alongside the capture and image-quality measures to provide an overall summary of site operations for May 2020.
